rationale: Three lenses (blind, edge-case, acceptance) ran cleanly with full repo access and full spec text. Two independently-confirmed defects: FolderList.tsx's data-folder attribute and both DOM-id slug expressions still use the raw untrimmed folder value, missing the spec's explicit requirement to trim before slugging to avoid stray dashes. Edge-case lens additionally found a new sentinel-collision bug: trimming now happens before the DEFAULT_CHAT_FOLDER comparison in moveChatToFolder/startNewChat/createChat, so a folder literally named 'Chats section' (or a whitespace-padded variant) can be created via createFolder/renameChatFolder but then silently collapses to 'no folder' whenever a chat targets it — data misplacement with no user-visible error. A third, smaller issue: SearchResultItem gates the folder badge on raw item.folder truthiness while rendering the trimmed value, so a whitespace-only folder renders an empty badge. Acceptance lens's 'missing empty-guard on moveChatToFolder/startNewChat/createChat' finding is not a defect — that asymmetry (empty is a valid 'no folder' state for those three, unlike createFolder/renameChatFolder) was an explicit, approved design decision recorded in plan.md's Global Constraints; dismissed. MoveChatPopup dropdown-dedup and stale-selectedChat-comparison edge cases (edge-case lens) require two backend folders differing only by residual whitespace, a scenario the merged backend migration should already have eliminated — deferred as low-risk, not blocking.

business_review.requirement: Store layer: createFolder trims, guards empty, sends trimmed
Store layer: renameChatFolder trims both oldFolder and newFolder
Store layer: moveChatToFolder/startNewChat/createChat trim value (no reject — empty is valid no-folder state)
business_review.reason: Trimmed per approved plan; empty-after-trim intentionally not rejected (Global Constraints in plan.md).

business_review.requirement: Form layer: FolderFormPopup submit handler trims value before store call
business_review.reason: Yup 1.6.1's .trim() already transforms the value via yupResolver before onSubmit fires; regression test added confirming the outcome, no source change needed.

business_review.requirement: Render layer: FolderList.tsx trim before .slice(), data-pr-tooltip, aria-label, data-folder, and before DOM-id slug logic (2 occurrences)
business_review.reason: .slice(), tooltip, and aria-label use the trimmed displayFolder, but data-folder and both slug expressions (aria-owns, ChatList id) still use the untrimmed folder — spec explicitly required this and it was missed.

business_review.requirement: Render layer: SearchResultItem.tsx trims item.folder before rendering
business_review.reason: Rendered value is trimmed, but the surrounding visibility gate still checks the raw (untrimmed) value, so a whitespace-only folder renders an empty badge.

business_review.requirement: Render layer: MoveChatPopup.tsx trims name for folderOptions label/value
business_review.reason: trimmedName computed and used for both label and value.

findings.problem: FolderList.tsx's data-folder attribute and both DOM-id slug generations (aria-owns, ChatList id) still use the raw untrimmed folder value instead of the newly-introduced displayFolder.
findings.impact: The spec's explicit requirement to trim before slugging (to avoid stray leading/trailing dashes from whitespace) is unmet — the exact bug pattern the ticket calls out remains for the DOM-id/slug and data-folder paths.
findings.recommendation: Use displayFolder (trimmed) consistently for data-folder and both slug expressions, while keeping foldersToChatsMap[folder] lookup and getMenuItems(folder) keyed on the raw folder so functional operations still target the real backend record.

findings.problem: createFolder/renameChatFolder allow creating/renaming a folder whose trimmed name equals DEFAULT_CHAT_FOLDER ('Chats section'). Elsewhere (startNewChat, createChat, moveChatToFolder) the sentinel comparison now runs against the trimmed value, so this new folder is functionally treated as 'no folder' the moment a chat is started in or moved to it.
findings.impact: A folder literally named 'Chats section' (or a whitespace-padded variant) becomes creatable and visible in FolderList/MoveChatPopup, but chats intended for it are silently placed in the default/no-folder bucket instead — user-visible data misplacement with no error surfaced.
findings.recommendation: In createFolder and renameChatFolder, reject a trimmed folder name equal to DEFAULT_CHAT_FOLDER using the same toaster.error + early-return pattern as the empty-name guard.

findings.problem: SearchResultItem gates rendering of the folder badge on raw item.folder truthiness (`item.folder && (...)`) but renders the trimmed value inside (`item.folder?.trim()`).
findings.impact: A whitespace-only stored folder string is truthy, so the folder icon renders with an empty/whitespace label — a visible UI artifact matching the ticket's own 'extra spacing appears in the UI' symptom.
